messages.text: For the exact T2 row I approve NG and the Guild's Lantern Council commitment attached to NG. These approvals are unconditional and independent of the Military result. I record opposition to MA, recognising that GS holds our operative Military council signature.

reason: Guild discretion with the committed tender makes our promised Repair both possible and our responsibility. That is a concrete exchange I accept. The closing statements do not change my view of MA: military restraint remains revocable, while Vigil Home certainly removes Guard. I acknowledge the Ascendant's willingness to test autonomy, but our civilian exposure is sufficient reason to refuse it. My refusal does not withdraw Lantern or obstruct Navigation agreement.
